column1: # B1152 missile_oracle.tsv — per-leg cast/act/death + flight/Middle/arrival, with video frame indices.
# fps = 30  (ffprobe r_frame_rate=30/1 on BOTH m1_rig38/video.mp4 and m2_rig54/video.mp4;
#            the calibration file's marker_frame is the 10 Hz t0 marker, NOT the video fps).
# t_video = (event epoch - calibrated_t0), seconds   [all-opcodes.tsv + video.calibration.tsv]
# frame   = round(t_video * fps)                     [frame index into the 30 fps video.mp4]
# Column provenance (each value traceable to a stated formula):
#   bc1_v/act1_v/death1_v  = OP_BeginCast / OP_Action / OP_Death ticks, video-relative
#                            (exact; re-derive from all-opcodes.tsv + video.calibration.tsv).
#   *_frame                = round(_v * 30).
#   flight_start/end       = first / last video frame the in-flight missile is visible in the
#                            caster<->target gap (per-frame brightness census of video.mp4,
#                            deep-gap box x660-760 y440-620, >=180 grayscale, pre-cast baseline).
#   middle_onset           = flight_start (the visible missile IS the Middle emitter).
#   middle_end             = middle_onset + middle_life_s  (M1 edd 279 life = 0.250 s).
#   arrival_onset          = first video frame the target impact burst is visible (per-frame
#                            census; the Target-stage emitters). The server-authoritative
#                            resolution is act1_v (OP_Action), which precedes the visible
